ios.desc:
Sc4nR is your all-in-one scanning solution. Scan QR codes, barcodes, NFC tags, and extract text from images - all in one privacy-focused app.
Key Features

QR Code & Barcode Scanner: Supports QR, EAN, UPC, Code 128, Aztec, PDF417, Data Matrix, and more
NFC Tag Reader: Instantly read NFC tags and cards
Live Text Recognition: Extract text from any surface in real-time
Advanced Camera Controls: Switch lenses, adjust zoom, manual focus for small codes
Complete History: Search, filter, favorite, and export your scans
Code Regeneration: View scanned QR codes and barcodes as images

Privacy First

100% Offline: Works without internet connection
No Data Collection: Your scans never leave your device
No Accounts: No sign-up required
No Ads: Clean, distraction-free experience

Export & Share
Export your scan history in CSV, JSON, or text format. Filter by date and scan type. Share individual scans or export multiple items at once.
Designed for Everyone
Clean, intuitive interface with full support for Light and Dark mode. Available in English and Japanese.
Download Sc4nR and take control of your scanning needs.

quotes.text:
Location: Kyoto, Japan
Remote: Yes. Working hours are flexible, overlap with US business hours is available.
Willing to relocate: No
Technologies: Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, C#/.NET 8, .NET MAUI, ASP.NET Core, TypeScript/Node.js, PostgreSQL; applied cryptography (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, AES-256-GCM, MLS/RFC 9420), FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, OpenID Connect, JWT
Résumé/CV: on request by email
Email: cb@kyototech.jp

Senior engineer with more than 15 years of professional experience, available now for contract work, full-time or part-time. Small jobs are welcome.

I build and ship mobile and backend software where security matters. My own iOS apps are in the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755644278 and https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748547975). I wrote the SaQura cryptography libraries for .NET, Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript and Python, published on NuGet, Maven Central, npm and PyPI, so the code is there to read: https://github.com/KyotoTechLLC/saqura-samples

Typical work: an iOS or Android release that is stuck on signing or store review; a .NET MAUI or Xamarin app that needs repair; passkey and token-based login done properly; end-to-end encryption; a prototype that has to become a product.

Earlier projects include a secure messenger platform for forensic medicine and a cross-platform app for ground operations at a major German airport. I invoice as a contractor and provide the W-8 form.
